name: Access Portal
purpose: Request access to GitHub, AWS, and SaaS tools. Approvals route to managers automatically.
how_to_get_access: Available to all employees via SSO.

name: Deploy Console
purpose: Deploy builds to staging and production, canary rollouts, and one-click rollback.
how_to_get_access: Request 'aws-prod-deploy' in the Access Portal; requires manager approval and Production Safety training.

name: FlagHouse
purpose: Feature flag management for gradual rollouts.
how_to_get_access: All engineers have access by default.

name: Incident Tracker
purpose: Declare incidents, page on-call, track timelines and follow-ups.
how_to_get_access: All employees can declare an incident.

name: Billing Admin
purpose: View customer invoices, apply credits and refunds.
how_to_get_access: Support leads and Payments team only. Request via Access Portal with manager approval.

name: HR Portal
purpose: Time off requests, pay and tax settings, benefits, working-abroad requests.

name: Navan
purpose: Book all business travel (flights, hotels) and submit expenses.

name: Approved AI Tools
purpose: List of AI assistants approved for company data: Claude (Acme Enterprise workspace) and Ingestion. Customer data may only be used with tools on this list.
how_to_get_access: Claude Enterprise seats requested via Access Portal.
